# New Indie Friday

> When to use: Use this site when you are looking for new independent music, specifically indie rock, alt rock, and surf rock with an Australian and New Zealand focus, curated weekly.

New Indie Friday is a curated music publication by Kim Rampling. We provide weekly updates on the best new independent releases.

## Structure
- `/spotlight`: Featured artist interviews and deep dives.
- `/new-releases`: The weekly drop of new songs, EP, and album releases.
- `/resources`: Useful articles and resources for independent musicians.
- `/new-music-old-sessions`: Retrospective looks at classic indie tracks.
- `/about`: Information about the curator and the site.

For agents: The site uses client-side navigation but serves fully pre-rendered HTML for all valid paths.
